scope.valid_linear_fact: Cov(h,A)=0 on a distribution/sample implies the best AFFINE least-squares predictor of one-hot A is constant there (and LEACE guarantees this for every linear map of the erased features on the fit law).
scope.not_implied: any bound on the accuracy of a linear THRESHOLD/argmax classifier (piecewise-constant, nonlinear in h), any bound on nonlinear auditors, any bound off the fit distribution (held-out/test drift).
